findings.reason: The first implementation treated evidence descriptors as one fixed layer and keyed lookups with a stale three-part locator, causing valid memory/tool inputs to fail. Fixed with a two-layer locator contract and regression coverage.

An empty task_state produced a synthetic selected source observation even though project_context emits no task message. Fixed so empty task state has a zero-count layer summary and no fabricated source.

A caller could recompute projection_sha256 after adding a kept evidence item absent from source, and the explanation would silently ignore it. The observed regression returned complete; fixed to refuse projection_shape_mismatch without echoing the body.
The missing-metadata test recomputed projection_sha256 while the old hash was still inside the hashed manifest, producing a false mismatch. Fixed to hash the manifest without projection_sha256.

Required independent fresh-context review did not produce a verdict. The default review route failed after five 403/503 retries; the bounded model-specific review and exec retry read the diff but were terminated after repeated telemetry/provider stalls without a conclusion. Landing remains held.
